title: Open Org idea
description: An idea an organisation is developing or seeking to deliver — themes, place, cost range, status. A thin discovery schema for the Murmurations index; the full idea is fetched via open_org_idea_url. See https://openorg.good-ship.co.uk for context.

linked_schemas.title: Linked Schemas
linked_schemas.description: Identifies the schemas the idea is published against.

org_id_guide.title: org-id.guide identifier
org_id_guide.description: The organisation's identifier in org-id.guide format (e.g. GB-CHC-1234567).

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable name for the idea (from summary or slug).

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Open Org theme keys describing what the idea addresses.

primary_area.title: Primary area
primary_area.description: Human-readable name of the idea's primary place.

geolocation.title: Geolocation
geolocation.description: Latitude/longitude of the idea's primary place.

cost_min.title: Cost minimum
cost_min.description: Minimum estimated cost in the idea's currency.

cost_max.title: Cost maximum
cost_max.description: Maximum estimated cost in the idea's currency.

cost_currency.title: Cost currency
cost_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the cost range.

schema_version.title: Open Org schema version
schema_version.description: Version of the Open Org idea schema.

open_org_idea_url.title: Open Org idea URL
open_org_idea_url.description: URL of the full idea JSON, served by the organisation's host.

schema.name: open_org_idea-v0.1.0
schema.purpose: Federated discovery of organisation ideas. Funders can find ideas by theme, place, status, and cost range.
